relationships.subject: SB366791
relationships.evidence_quote: SB366791 administration increased the HHWT in young, but not aged SAMP8 mice.

relationships.subject: Tranilast
relationships.evidence_quote: Tranilast administration increased the HHWT in aged, but not young SAMP8 mice.

key_findings: Aged SAMP8 mice had higher palatal heat withdrawal threshold than young mice.
Young mice had more TRPV1-IR small neurons and fewer TRPV2-IR medium neurons; TRPV1 antagonism affected young and TRPV2 antagonism affected aged mice.
